_comment: CATALOG ENTRY SCHEMA — one entry per content item in catalog.json.
_comment2: catalog.json is written by the render-and-catalog step after a content item is verified and stored.
_comment3: The front end reads catalog.json to build navigation and filter views without loading every content file.
subject: math
cluster: Analyze proportional relationships and use them to solve real-world and mathematical problems
_comment_scope: scope is 'standard' (set `standard`, leave `clusterId` null) or 'cluster' (set `clusterId`, set `standard` to null).
_comment_tier: tier is null normally, or 'tier1'|'tier2' for the two worksheets of a complex (two-worksheet) standard.
_comment_difficulty: difficulty is null for everything except legacy worksheets, which carry 'Easy'|'Medium'|'Hard'.
_comment_id_convention: IDs use double-dash as delimiter. Standard scope: {standard}--{materialType} for lessons/quizzes; {standard}--worksheet (single ramped) OR {standard}--worksheet--tier1 / --tier2 (complex) OR legacy {standard}--worksheet--{difficulty-lowercase}. Cluster scope: {clusterId}--cluster-worksheet and {clusterId}--cluster-test, where clusterId = {gradeCode}.{domainCode}.{clusterCode}.
